name: 21040 · Edgewood, MD
findings: ZIP 21040 (Edgewood) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21040 (Edgewood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21040 (Edgewood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
